events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1, 1981, with the first video played being "Video Killed The Radio Star" by The Buggles.

angles.name: MTV Launch Angle
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Forty-five years ago, MTV burst onto screens, kicking off with a track that proved eerily prophetic. What was the first video you ever saw on MTV?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring tracks like "Supersonic" and "Live Forever".

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Angle
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. Which track from their iconic debut still gets you singing along?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal event in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, featuring 32 acts and attracting nearly half a million people.

angles.name: Woodstock Angle
angles.copy: Peace, love, and three days of music that defined a generation. Fifty-seven years ago, Woodstock made history. If you could have been there, which artist would you have seen?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since the world lost a legend. Elvis Presley's music continues to define rock and roll. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and passed away six days later, leaving an undeniable mark on music.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Three decades since we lost one of hip-hop's most profound voices. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is still felt today. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Celebrated guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, cementing his legacy as a rock icon.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost a true guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix's influence continues to inspire generations of musicians. Which of his solos is your all-time favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring the legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Angle
angles.copy: The album cover that launched a thousand conspiracy theories and some of the greatest songs ever recorded. Fifty-seven years since 'Abbey Road' hit the streets. What's your standout track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman has given us decades of iconic rock. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine" was originally released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, a little white box changed everything. The original iPod dropped, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket.' How many songs are in your pocket now?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy and incredible theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Visionary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Angle
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse 'White Album'. Which track from this double LP stands out most for you?
